facts.fact: The INIC and UNU-EGOV digital governance strategy of June 2020 states that DGRN, with INIC, began developing an electronic birth registration system with issuance of the corresponding certificates in 2016, and that the Sistema Integrado de Gestão de Assentos (SIGA) is in production, still under continuous improvement.
facts.system: Sistema Integrado de Gestão de Assentos (SIGA)

facts.fact: The strategy states that the Direção Geral de Registo e Notariado (DGRN) began developing the electronic birth registration system in 2016 with INIC's support, and that SIGA runs on a cloud platform from the University of Aveiro, Portugal.
facts.system: Sistema Integrado de Gestão de Assentos (SIGA)

facts.fact: The strategy states that the electronic birth registration system was begun in 2016 under the PASP PALOP-TL project for improving public services, with European Union support; no domestic budget line is stated.
